text: Regional and local governments should have the autonomy to decide their own affairs without relying on the national government.
The whole country should follow the same laws, even when its regions prefer otherwise.
Laws should be made and public services managed as close to local communities as possible.
A single national school curriculum is better than allowing each region to set its own.
Each state or province should be free to draft its own constitution without interference from the national government.
A single national police force would work better than several autonomous regional forces.
Most tax revenue should remain in the region or municipality where it was collected.
Public healthcare should follow uniform national guidelines under a central authority.
Regions should have the right to secede if a local majority votes for it.
Regional taxes should follow national rules to prevent tax disputes between regions.
Indigenous and traditional communities should be able to live under their own rules within their territories.
Labor laws should be the same in every region, with no regional variations.
Municipalities should be able to pass their own laws, even if they differ from national laws.
When a regional and a national leader disagree, the national leader should have the final say.
My country should be a union of regions with broad political autonomy.
The national government should be able to overturn regional and local laws that conflict with the national interest.
Regions with a strong cultural identity should have more political autonomy.
A region should not be allowed to secede, even with the support of its local population.
Public education should be managed by local governments rather than the national government.
Regional and local leaders should carry out central government decisions on local matters.
Free elections must be kept even when they elect bad governments.
In serious crises, a strong leader should be able to govern without depending on the legislature.
The political opposition should have the right to criticize any government in public.
Voters with little political knowledge should have less influence over who governs.
Constitutional courts, such as a supreme court, should be able to strike down majority-backed laws that violate the constitution.
A competent leader should be able to govern without frequent elections or mandatory changes in leadership.
Secret and universal suffrage is non-negotiable, even for poorly informed voters.
An effective leader should be able to remain in power without facing regular elections.
The people should be able to overturn laws by referendum, without depending on the legislature.
Leaders should be chosen by competence, tradition, or succession rather than by popular vote.
Voters should be able to remove a bad politician from office before the end of the term.
I would prefer an authoritarian regime to democracy if it accelerated my country's development.
Public offices could be filled by randomly selected citizens, as juries are, rather than by election.
Experts selected for their qualifications should govern without being elected by the public.
Those who govern should have the consent and approval of the people affected by their decisions.
The right to vote should be restricted; not every adult should be allowed to vote.
I would prefer a society governed by popular assemblies rather than political leaders.
Major reforms should not be interrupted by frequent elections or changes in government.
Even a government elected by a huge majority must respect all the rights of the opposition.
I would prefer an autocratic regime that guarantees order, security, and prosperity over electoral democracy.
Aggressive police operations are justified to fight crime in areas controlled by criminal groups.
Adult cannabis use should be legalized or decriminalized.
The state should be allowed to monitor digital conversations to prevent and combat crime.
Freedom of speech should protect even opinions considered offensive.
Facial recognition cameras in the streets should be expanded to reduce crime.
Consensual activities among adults, such as drug use, gambling, and sex work, should not be criminalized.
The state should be able to dissolve political parties that threaten public order.
All drugs, including cocaine, should be legalized for adults.
Civilian access to firearms should be severely restricted by law.
Adults should be allowed to keep firearms at home for personal protection.
In serious situations, the government should be allowed to impose a curfew.
Voluntary euthanasia should be legalized for people suffering from terminal illnesses.
Vaccination should be mandatory, even against the will of those who refuse.
When guilt is uncertain, the state should avoid a conviction even if some guilty people go free.
The death penalty should be adopted for crimes such as rape and murder.
Any law that bans what adults do in private is an abuse by the state.
The government should be able to take down accounts that spread false information.
The government should not be allowed to track purchases made through digital payment systems.
Terrorism suspects should be held without trial until the threat has passed.
No one should be forced to unlock their phone for the police.
Those who immigrate to a country should learn the language and adopt local customs.
A multicultural society should live with several languages in everyday life.
Closing the borders may be necessary to preserve a country's cultural identity.
A country should allow immigrants to preserve their customs and traditions, even when these differ from local ones.
A country should refuse entry to immigrants who reject local customs.
Immigrants should not have to abandon their customs to live well in the country.
Preserving national traditions matters more than accommodating foreign customs.
The coexistence of different languages and cultures should be encouraged in a country.
Countries have the right to prefer immigrants from cultures similar to their own.
Cultures brought by immigrants should have a place in a country's national identity.
People who immigrate to a country should be required to adapt to local customs.
My country should continue to welcome immigrants from countries facing severe crises.
Fluency in the country's main language should be a priority in immigration policy.
Immigrants should not be judged by customs attributed to their country of origin.
Neighborhoods whose immigrant residents remain culturally isolated create problems for the country.
Children of immigrants should also be able to study in their parents' language, in bilingual schools.
Immigration should be limited to preserve the country's predominant culture.
Borders should be open: any peaceful person could live in any country.
Immigrants who reject local customs should lose the right to remain in the country.
The idea of national identity is outdated: we are all citizens of the world.
A country should maintain strong armed forces to earn respect abroad.
Negotiation and diplomacy must be exhausted before any military action.
Preemptive strikes are acceptable against enemies preparing to attack.
Wars are almost never worth it, even against hostile regimes.
My country should prioritize military spending even when other areas need resources.
Diplomatic negotiations should take priority over expanding the military arsenal.
My country should pursue nuclear weapons to avoid relying on protection from any foreign power.
Reducing military spending should be a priority to lower the risk of war.
Mandatory military service is necessary to prepare a country for war.
Disarmament agreements should take priority over expanding military arsenals.
The ability to manufacture weapons domestically is essential to national defense.
No political or ideological cause justifies starting a war.
Espionage and covert military operations are legitimate tools of a state.
My country should support international courts that hear war-crimes cases, including cases involving allies.
Drones and autonomous weapons provide a decisive advantage, and my country should develop them.
My country should engage in dialogue even with hostile regimes before threatening military action.
My country should be ready to start a war if that secures its vital interests.
My country should abolish its armed forces.
Peace only exists when the enemy knows the response to an attack will be devastating.
The United Nations should be able to mediate conflicts before any military action.
No country has the right to try to change another country's government.
Pressuring other countries is legitimate when the national interest is at stake.
My country should avoid military alliances that could draw it into conflicts abroad.
Foreign policy should prioritize my country's influence over its neighbors.
My country should not send soldiers abroad, not even on peacekeeping missions.
My country should use its weight to defend its companies abroad.
Even in the face of a genocide in a neighboring country, my country should not get involved militarily.
My country should be allowed to impose sanctions when its interests are threatened.
Conflicts between countries should be resolved by international organizations, not by great powers.
My country should exercise political leadership over its region.
My country should avoid joining exclusive geopolitical blocs.
Influencing neighboring governments is acceptable when it increases my country's security.
Each nation should solve its own problems without outside interference.
My country should be willing to use military force to protect its interests in its region.
My country should not impose sanctions on countries whose governments it disapproves of.
No international treaty should count for more than the national interest.
My country should remain neutral in wars, even under pressure from allies.
Defending national interests should guide my country's actions abroad.
My country should not maintain military bases in other countries.
My country should pressure neighboring governments that threaten its citizens.
A revolution may be necessary to take economic power out of the hands of the few.
Public services should be provided by private companies when there is competition.
Companies considered strategically important should remain under public control.
Healthcare should be provided mainly through private enterprise.
Large companies should belong to their workers rather than private owners.
Even roads, police, and courts could be managed by private companies.
When the market excludes the poor, the state should take over the service directly.
Family inheritance should be protected from policies that redistribute wealth.
Healthcare, education, and water should not operate under the logic of profit.
Collecting taxes is, in the end, a form of theft.
The state should guarantee a minimum income to every citizen in need.
Lifetime job security for public employees should be limited or eliminated.
The state should limit the power of large private companies.
Cash assistance programs should have a maximum duration.
Land reform is still a necessary measure in my country.
Workers should negotiate wages directly with employers, without unions.
Public banks should continue to finance the country's development.
Private property must be respected even when it generates great inequality.
The risk of selling state-owned companies for less than they are worth justifies keeping them under public control.
Private companies should take priority in the management of public services.
The government should plan strategic sectors such as energy, housing, and industry.
Prices and wages should be set by the market without government intervention.
The central bank should obey the elected government, not act with total independence.
Companies should set the terms of employment with minimal government interference.
The wealthiest people should pay more taxes to fund public programs.
Taxes should be reduced to encourage economic growth.
The state should subsidize strategically important domestic industries.
The minimum wage should not be set too high, because that reduces jobs available to the poorest workers.
In serious crises, the government should be able to freeze rents.
The government should not freeze prices, even during periods of high inflation.
The government should select and support leading domestic companies in strategic sectors.
Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin should be able to compete freely with government money.
An economy fully planned by the state would work better than the free market.
The state should avoid new regulations on economic activity.
During a recession, the government should spend more to stimulate the economy, even if that increases public debt.
An independent central bank is worth more than the current government's political wishes.
The government should be able to control the exchange rate to protect the national economy.
The central bank should be abolished, leaving money and interest rates to the market.
A minimum wage set by law protects workers more than free negotiation does.
Those who have money should be able to send it abroad without asking the government's permission.
Domestic industries should be protected with tariffs whenever necessary.
Tariffs should be cut to almost zero, even if some domestic industries fail.
I prefer limiting imports to protect industrial jobs, even if prices rise.
My country should pursue free trade agreements with other countries.
My country should produce domestically everything it consumes, even paying much more for it.
Foreign products should face few economic restrictions when entering the country.
The government should limit imports that threaten local industry and jobs.
The world would be better off without economic borders, working as a single global market.
Foreign companies should be banned from buying my country's strategically important companies.
My country should deepen trade ties with other countries.
Domestic food production should take priority over cheap imports.
I support making it easier for foreign investors to invest in my country.
Purchases by governments and state-owned companies should give priority to domestic companies.
International trade should be expanded to support economic development.
Cheap Chinese electric cars should pay tariffs to protect local factories.
My country should reduce import tariffs that raise consumer prices.
Strategic supply chains, such as medicines and chips, should be protected from foreign competition.
Multinational companies are beneficial because they create jobs and train local workers.
Economic sovereignty is worth more than low prices at the supermarket.
Global economic integration should be deepened through more trade.
Religion is a personal matter and should not influence public policy.
Faith should be the guide for my moral and political choices.
Laws should be neutral and not follow the values of any religion.
The country's laws should reflect the values of the majority religion.
Churches and temples should pay taxes like any other organization.
Religion strengthens community life and should be encouraged.
Public buildings, such as schools and courts, should not display religious symbols.
My country should officially adopt a religious identity.
Political decisions should not be based on religious beliefs.
Religious traditions should be passed on to future generations.
A society without religion would be preferable to a religious society.
Society should give more room to faith in God.
Religious holidays should not be official in a secular state.
Marriage should be recognized as a religious institution.
The word 'God' should not appear in the constitution or in political speeches.
Religious faith is necessary to give life meaning.
Religion should not be part of young children's education.
When the law of men contradicts the law of God, the law of God comes first.
Public morality does not need to be based on belief in God.
Religious faith is part of the national identity and deserves protection.
Same-sex couples should have the same right to adopt children as other couples.
The traditional family should serve as a model for society.
The gender identity declared by each person must be respected.
Cultural changes that come too fast end up destabilizing the whole of society.
Race-based quotas are still needed to address inequality.
Real marriage is between a man and a woman.
LGBT couples should be able to show affection in public like any other couple.
Race-based quotas should be ended to avoid divisions along racial lines.
Abortion early in pregnancy can be a morally acceptable choice.
Abortion is wrong because it ends a human life.
Teenagers should learn about sexuality and gender without taboos.
Children's sex education should follow the family's values, not the school's.
Sex work should be recognized as legitimate work.
Gender-neutral language should not be adopted by society.
Reducing meat consumption out of respect for animals is a moral advance.
Using pornography or drugs is a sign of moral decline.
Open relationships and polyamory are choices as legitimate as traditional marriage.
A woman's most important role is caring for the family and the home.
Nudity in films, art, and on beaches should not be considered offensive.
Parents should be the final authority in their children's moral education.
Nuclear energy, AI, and genetic engineering should be embraced without excessive fear.
Humanity would live better with less technology, in a simpler, more natural way of life.
AI and automation are welcome, even if they eliminate many of today's professions.
Technologies that alter the human body, mind, or reproduction should be restricted.
Genetically modified crops should continue to be developed.
Pesticide use should be reduced, even if that lowers agricultural productivity.
Mining should be allowed even in areas of preserved forest in the Amazon.
Preserved nature is worth more than accelerated industrial growth.
Gene editing should be permitted to increase intelligence and prevent disease.
Reducing the use of natural resources should take priority in the fight against global warming.
Humanity should invest in exploring other planets.
Even low-impact mining in the Amazon rainforest crosses a line that should not be crossed.
Life in big cities is preferable to life in the countryside.
Editing embryos to choose intelligence or looks crosses an ethical line.
Brain implants are a legitimate way to expand human abilities.
Spending on space exploration should take lower priority than environmental protection on Earth.
Lab-grown meat should replace some livestock farming.
A simple life in the countryside is preferable to life in large cities.
Against global warming, relying on technology makes more sense than cutting consumption.
The human body should not be enhanced with chips and artificial modifications.
